avis.titre: There's a reason this is so popular globally!

The oil cleanser also gets a bit messy as the liquid falls down your arms while rubbing it into your face. This product is very hydrating and I will continue using it to track any differences in my skin in the coming months. Why not give this product a try? :)

I have very sensitive middle-aged skin, and yhe wrong product can give me zits, raw spots, or peeling and burning areas. The ingredients are all super "clean", rating an 'excellent' on the yuka app & on the EWG website. I've bought this cleanser duo for friends and all of them are now hooked! I cannot recommend this product or the partnering cream cleanser any more highly for an excellent double cleansing routine for highly sensitive skin.
